fields.name: cpu_intel_effective_frequency_mhz
fields.meaning: Per-logical-processor C0 interval average derived from ΔAPERF / ΔMPERF × CPUID.16H EAX[15:0] declared base frequency; excludes idle time

fields.name: gpu_amd_npu_activity_percent
fields.meaning: ADLX IADLXGPUMetrics1::NPUActivityLevel percent for the exact AMD ADLX GPU target; separate vendor report from DXCore engine busy time and not an NPU adapter identity mapping

fields.name: network_all_rx_errors_actual
fields.meaning: Windows driver-reported MIB_IF_ROW2 InErrors cumulative unsigned counter; not application payload or independent wire measurement

fields.name: npu_all_engine_busy_percent
fields.meaning: Engine busy time using the same engine-running-time algorithm as Task Manager: maximum per-engine running-time delta ratio across the complete bound engine directory; numeric equality with Task Manager is not asserted

fields.name: memory_all_numa_node_capacity_mib
fields.meaning: PerfOS NUMA Node Memory\Total MBytes NumberOfItems32; reported as binary MiB rounded down per OS node; process memory-partition view, not exact bytes or installed DIMM capacity

fields.name: storage_all_nvme_composite_temperature_celsius
fields.meaning: NVMe controller/global composite temperature; Kelvin converted to Celsius
